notes.title: NABOKI - Cloud Save and more.
notes.content:
As I said, every puzzle game I made will get an update. This is the first one of a series. 

- Added "Cloud Save" - please let me know if it works. There is a chance that I messed something up. 
- Added a few levels. 
- Mouse scroll Zooms camera.
- Fullscreen rework.
- Some versions of Linux may work better now.
- Bug fixes, smoother animations. 

Working on a dark mode. 

More updates soon, after I finish making Hook 2:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1871310/Hook_2/
